profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Spectacles (Snap Inc.)
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Spectacles (Snap Inc.) - Spectacles Cloud team

Seasoned software developer with more than 12 years of professional experience (including 4-years at Amazon) building out APIs and big data pipelines. I have worked on all kinds of software challenges at various companies of all sizes from a small tech startup to multiple publicly traded corporations (TRUE, AMZN, AFRM, SNAP).
